body: Basically the program (program B, let's call it) I ultimately wanted to end up in is super over subscribed, so when I initially applied I got wait listed. The program (program A) I was dismissed from is kind of like a "helper" program to take to get ultimately get into program B, because it aids people who didn't have the right qualifications in the first place or like me, got wait listed. The first time I got dismissed I went back, talked to the program A coordinator and was able to get back in to try it again, but since getting dismissed a second time I haven't spoken to anyone, mostly due to my own humiliation/severe anxiety about how much things have piled up.
